name: 锥尾羊
evolution: 锥尾羊 → 铃兰羊 Lv.20 → 花影羚羊 Lv.32
description: 白色的毛十分蓬松，脚掌柔软，移动时悄无声息，因此很擅长藏身草原与坡地。它性格安静，同类之间常用轻轻顶犄角的方式交流。
descriptionEn: Its white fur is very fluffy and its soles are soft, so it moves silently and is good at hiding in grasslands and on slopes. It has a quiet personality, and members of the same species usually communicate by gently butting horns.

skills.name: 恶能量
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 幻象
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 虚假破产
skills.description: 减伤80%，能量不足时，消耗5%生命代替1能量，应对攻击。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 80%; when energy is insufficient, consumes 5% HP in place of 1 energy; counters attacks.

skills.name: 降灵
skills.descriptionEn: Inflicts 1 stack of Spirit Descent Mark on the enemy.

skills.name: 撕咬
skills.description: 造成物伤，3连击，若自己的生命低于50%，本次技能连击数+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 3 hits; if its own HP is below 50%, this skill's combo count +2.

skills.name: 力量吞噬
skills.description: 敌方获得全技能威力-20，自己获得全技能威力+20。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gets all skills power -20, and it gains all skills power +20.

skills.name: 见招拆招
skills.description: 造成物伤，若上回合使用状态技能，本次技能威力+55。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if a status skill was used last turn, this skill's power +55.

skills.name: 恶作剧
skills.description: 敌方失去3能量，应对防御：改为敌方失去6能量。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy loses 3 energy; countering defense: the enemy loses 6 energy instead.

skills.name: 极限撕裂
skills.description: 造成物伤，若自己生命高于50%，使用后自己获得双攻-50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if its own HP is above 50%, after use it gets both offenses -50%.

skills.name: 恶意逃离
skills.description: 脱离，应对防御：额外使敌方攻击技能能耗+4。
skills.descriptionEn: Withdraws; countering defense: additionally the enemy's attack skills cost +4 energy.

skills.name: 坟场搏击
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方每有1能量，本次技能威力-10%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; for each energy the enemy has, this skill's power -10%.
